about: Past the hourly limit (1,000 an hour for no key, by X-RateLimit-Limit): USGS answers 429, with a Retry-After of minutes, which A5 does not read. Failed, not denied: there is no key to paste, and a later pass goes on. The body as USGS gave it, 10-13.

error.message: You have exceeded your rate limit. Make sure you provided your API key from https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/signup/, then either try again later or contact us at https://waterdata.usgs.gov/questions-comments/?referrerUrl=https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov for assistance.

catch.words: USGS's water data API answered HTTP 429 for /collections/latest-continuous/items; a 429 is its hourly limit, and passes
